from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InvestmentCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Investment cash flow net amount extracted from one quarterly report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name, e.g. 格力电器")
    fiscal_year: int | None = Field(description="Year of the report, e.g. 2019")
    fiscal_quarter: str | None = Field(description="Quarter of the fiscal year, e.g. '第一季度'")
    investment_cash_flow_net_amount: float | None = Field(description="Investment cash flow net amount for this period")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元'")
    current_period_formatted: str = Field(description="Original formatted number as shown in document")
    previous_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="Previous period amount for comparison, if reported in this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    investment_cash_flows: list[InvestmentCashFlow]
